propositions: Context-limit escalation on a provider-qualified run (bedrock) silently relocates to bare Anthropic model ids by comparing rung constants without the run's actual provider context

The _rung_target function derives both sides of provider comparison from MODEL_LADDER constant alone, ignoring cfg.model's provider qualifier, causing provider mismatches when class table is unconfigured
Pass-1 entry rung resolves to anthropic provider, so escalation targets degrade to bare forms even on primary's own rung, affecting common one-criterion retry before deep escalation

Threading the run's primary model into _rung_target enables provider-agreement comparison: matching providers return today's targets byte-for-byte, differing providers on higher rungs are dropped and reported as _too_big failure instead of silent provider jump
